D130 “斯滕斯比”号（S.S. "Stensby"）船员被解雇
1929年3月25日 E. KIESELBACH, JACOBSEN, ADILS
ERIKSSON, BORJISSON, H JOHANSEN

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 130
Date 25. 3. 19
File No.

(C.I.D.) Office Notes

A. D. C. I.,

The crew of eight men of the
S.S. "Stensby", referred to in the "China
Press" March 2nd, were dismissed in
accordance with a telegram received by
the captain from the company's head
office, for whom Messrs Dodwell & Co. Ltd.,
1, Canton Road are the local agents.
They were paid off by the Danish Consul,
Mr. Clemm Dubail.

Two members of the crew have
already been given employment in
other ships and the following are the
names of the others:-

Henry Johansen    Danish
H. Jacobsen       "
Th. Adils         Icelander
Th. Eiriksson     Swede
J. Borjisson      ditto
E. Kieselbach     Nationality
                  uncertain

Messrs Johansen, Jacobsen, Adils &
Borjisson are being supported financially
by the Danish Consul-General and Th.
Eiriksson is being supported by the Swedish
Consul General. These men are of excellent
character. The s.s. "Stensby" is due to again
arrive in Shanghai shortly when an
endeavour will be made officially by the
Danish Consul General to reinstate them
in their ship, failing which they will
be immediately repatriated. (sent home).
As Kieselbach's nationality is uncertain
and the German Consulate does not
recognize him, although he speaks
German fluently,
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处档案室
编号 I. O. D. 130
日期 1929年3月25日
档案号

（刑事侦缉处）办公室备注

助理刑事侦缉处长，

《字林西报》3月2日报道中提及的“斯滕斯比”号（S.S. "Stensby"）八名船员，已根据船长从公司总部收到的电报指示被解雇，该公司在当地的代理人为广东路1号的杜德威尔有限公司（Dodwell & Co. Ltd.）。
他们的遣散费由丹麦领事克莱姆·杜拜尔（Clemm Dubail）先生支付。

两名船员已在其他船只上找到工作，其余人员姓名如下：

Henry Johansen    丹麦人
H. Jacobsen       "
Th. Adils         冰岛人
Th. Eiriksson     瑞典人
J. Borjisson      同上
E. Kieselbach     国籍
                  不明

Johansen、Jacobsen、Adils 和 Borjisson 四位先生正由丹麦总领事提供经济资助，Th. Eiriksson 则由瑞典总领事提供资助。这些人品行优良。“斯滕斯比”号不久将再次抵达上海，届时丹麦总领事将正式努力使他们复职，若不成，他们将立即被遣送回国。由于 Kieselbach 的国籍不明，且德国领事馆不承认他，尽管他能流利地说德语，

page_data.en:
he is not being assisted financially
by the Danish Consul General.
Kieselback threatened the Captain
at the Danish Consulate and consequently
he is not considered reliable. He has
applied to the German Relief Society for
assistance.

March 23rd
1929.    John Hook

THE CHINA PRESS, THURSDAY, MARCH 21, 1929

German Crew
Replaced by Chinese,
Allege Injustice

A story of unfair treatment was
related by a deck hand of the
motor ship [□] to a press re-
presentative yesterday, during
which the statement was made
that the entire crew of the ship,
consisting of eight men in all, were
dismissed when the vessel put into
port here, and Chinese were en-
gaged in their place.

The informant, [□],
said that he, with the other mem-
bers of the crew, were engaged as
deck hands at [□], and the
vessel was bound for [□],
Vancouver and Seattle. Upon ar-
rival here they were informed that
their services were no longer need-

《字林西报》，1929年3月21日，星期四

德国船员
被华人取代，
声称遭受不公

昨日，一艘摩托艇 [□] 的一名甲板水手向新闻界代表讲述了一个遭受不公平待遇的故事，其间称该船全体船员共八人，在船舶进入本港时被解雇，并雇佣了中国人代替他们。

举报人 [□] 称，他与其他船员一起在 [□] 受雇为甲板水手，该船驶往 [□]、温哥华和西雅图。抵达此处后，他们被告知不再需要他们的服务。由于他们没有资金，并试图从领事那里获得 [□] 以寻求帮助。什么 [□] [□] 其中一名 [□] [□] 明确声明 [□] [□] 根据其 [□] [□] 拒绝提供帮助，理由是他是 [□] 出生在 [□] 难以证明 [□] 与丹麦领事的沟通未能就上述任何陈述给予满意答复或予以否认。
